text: Assumanu Mantiti is a Dunmer eggminer living in Gnisis in the West Gash.
Athal Nerano is a Dunmer Rogue living in Gnisis in the West Gash. Athal is an oathman of the House Hlaalu.

Athragar is a Bosmer spell merchant, Journeyman Alteration Trainer and member of the Mages Guild in who resides in the Chorrol Mages Guild. Because the Chorrol Mages Guild specializes in Conjuration magic, his wares include spells of that school. Of those present, the majority consist of Bound Items.

Astia Inventius is the wife of Pinarus Inventius and a resident of the city of Anvil. She lives in their house with her husband. Astia is usually hanging around the Anvil Docks painting the lighthouse and the hill it is sat atop. She seems to paint the same thing each day though. She brings a canvas, paint brush and paint palette with her, sometimes she wanders up the dock to converse with different people on the docks before returning to paint and then goes back to the house she shares with husband, Pinarus.
Ashanta is a Redguard fugitive who is hiding in Bloodmayne Cave. She is a criminal who broke out of the Bravil prison with Hlofgar, Dreet-Lai, and Enrion.

Astrid is the leader of the Dark Brotherhood in Skyrim and wife of another Dark Brotherhood member, Arnbjorn. She resides in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, near Falkreath, and holds the responsibility of finding new recruits in the Night Mother's absence.

Athis is a Dunmer warrior and a member of The Companions in . He resides in The Companions' mead hall, Jorrvaskr, in Whiterun. He is an Expert-level trainer in One-handed combat, and is also the only Dunmer among the current ranks of the Companions. Upon completion of the Companions' main plot line, Athis can be recruited as a follower and becomes a potential marriage candidate. He can be recruited into the Blades if the Dragonborn talks to Delphine while having him as a follower.
Asta is a Nord citizen and worshipper of Kynareth who can be found in Eldergleam Sanctuary along with Sond.
Atahbah is a Khajiit trader typically found traveling alongside Ri'saad with his caravan. After completing the Thieves Guild mission regarding the caravans, she becomes available as a fence.

Atar is a Nord mercenary found within Sanuarach Mine in the town of Karthwasten. According to dialogue, he was hired by the Silver-Blood Family, and is stationed at Karthwasten when the Dragonborn first arrives there.
Assallit Assunbahanammu is a Dunmer and ethnic Ashlander who resides at the Yanemus Mine.

Assatlit Assudnilamat is a Dunmer Scout who resides on Azura's Coast. Assatlit, as well as his campmates, Sannit Kil and Ibasour Sershurrapal, are hostile and will attack on sight. However, Assatlit can offer training training in Athletics, Block and Long Blade.
Assurdan Serdimapal is a Dunmer scout found in his yurt at the Kaushtababi Camp in the Azura's Coast region.
Athesie Andas is a Dunmer agent and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. She can be found on the upper level and is hostile.
Ashni is a Khajiit commoner and a devout worshipper of the Daedric prince Sanguine. She can be found at the Shrine of Sanguine along with her fellow worshippers.

Astinia Atius is an Imperial commoner who can be found in the Market District of the Imperial City. During the day, she wanders the Market District, speaking to the other citizens and generally going around her daily life. She wears a Russet Felt Outfit.
Atahba is a Khajiit who takes care of the horses at the Five Riders Stables in Leyawiin. She works for Cat-Face.

Athyn Llethan was the Dunmer King, High Councilor and Lord of Morrowind, and Duke of Mournhold in the late Third Era. He's also a character that was mentioned in Yellow Book of 3E 426 and during the events of .
Athelyn Malas is a Dunmer commoner found at the Temple Courtyard, in Mournhold.
Astien Masoriane is a Breton Spellsword, and bandit who resides in Elith-Pal Mine.
Asum is an Argonian Slave who can be found dead in the Arena of Rotheran.
Athel Baelborne is a Breton found near the Baelborne Rock ruins. He has tried to take over the estate but it appears to be haunted. Thus he asks for the Vestige's help.
Athanas Samori is a Dunmer bard residing in Mournhold. He performs various songs and tunes in front of The Flaming Nix Inn.
Asteril is an Altmer residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade. Asteril has a twin-sister, Laryaril, who pretended to be Asteril for a while.
Astewen is an Altmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Ashzu is an Orsimer residing in Alcaire Castle at the Fighters Guild hall.
Atin is a Redguard residing in Wayrest in the region of Stormhaven. She is a guild trader, and has her stand at the Guild Traders' market.
Atalmo is an Altmer who resides at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate in the province of Cyrodiil. He is a member of the Aldmeri Dominion.
Ateldil is an Altmer mystic found in the Mages Guild in Sentinel, Alik'r Desert.
Athemel is a Bosmer chef residing in the Silver Moons Inn in Baandari Trading Post, Malabal Tor.
Asska is an Argonian residing in the Banking District in Mournhold.
Athanin is a Breton backpack merchant residing at his stall, The Mule's Reprieve, in Bergama.
Ashenfur is a Khajiit slave found inside The Hissing Guar in Kragenmoor.
Athask is a Khajiit slave working at The Hissing Guar in Kragenmoor.
Asurn Ice-Breaker was a candidate for the role of High King in the 5th century of the First Era.
Ashalki is a Khajiit brewer and a member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Rawl'kha.
Asheeus is an Argonian siege merchant and member of the Ebonheart Pact who can be found at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Ashiyana is a Redguard fence and part of the group of outlaws found underneath Daggerfall.
Ashkhan Ginasa is a Dunmer Ashlander and the warchief of the Vereansu Tribe. He led the attack on Muth Gnaar.
Ashkhan Ziddak Dunhaki is a Dunmer Ashlander and the warchief of the Kagesh Tribe. He attacked Iliath Temple against the will of the tribe's wise woman, Farseer Tirinaat.
Ashur-Dissini is a Dunmer Ashlander found at the Thizzrini Arena.
Asiah is a Redguard commoner found in the Shadehome Inn in Riften.
Asjaila is a Redguard patron of The Withered Tree, in Riften.
Aspera Giant-Friend is a Dunmer helping the giants of Cradlecrush retrieve their lands.
Aspera the Forgotten is a Chimer ghost found in Eidolon's Hollow.
Assistant Ahaht-Ei is an Argonian found in the Hatching Pools.
Assistant Telixith is an Argonian found in the Hatching Pools.
Atald Cold-Moon is a Nord working at the Cold-Moon Fine Steeds, in Windhelm. He is infatuated with Nurara Mothran.
Athal Andas is a Dunmer member of the Black Daggers in who resides in Quickwater Cave. Defeating him grants the achievement Quickwater Cave Explorer.
Athando is a Dunmer patron of The Blasted Breton in Alten Corimont.
Atl-Xulith is an Argonian patron of the Riverside Inn, in Nimalten.
At'avar is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild trapped in Spindleclutch. He is also the son of Guardian Sud-Hareem.
Askar was the Harbinger of the Companions and predecessor to Kodlak Whitemane. Askar found Kodlak in Hammerfell, after which he took him back to Skyrim.
Ashgel is an Orsimer found in Clan Longhouse in the Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar. She is married to Balarkh.
Astius Octavinua is an Imperial found working on the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Astara Caerellius is an Imperial assassin residing in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and is the matron of the sanctuary.
Atildel is an Altmer Star-Gazer residing in the ruins of Sanctum Ophidia. She will return to her observatory in Belkarth after the quest "The Missing Guardian" is completed.
Aspera Arena-Friend is a Dunmer found in the Dragonstar Arena.
Atarus is an Ogrim boss that can be found at Blackheart Haven in Bangkorai. He acts as the crew's "chef," and cooks by boiling filth.
Atazha is a Redguard guild trader working at her stall, Atazha's Market, in Pilgrim's Market in Vivec City.
Astrimunde the Elder is a Nord beggar residing in Vivec City. Astrimunde has no unique dialogue.
Atli Ice-Heart is a Nord residing in her family home located in northwestern Cyrodiil.
Atanaz Charger is a generic character residing in Atanaz Ruins in
Assistant Bolvus is a Dunmer scholar residing in the Library of Vivec within the Temple Canton in Vivec City, Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Assistant Methas is a Dunmer scholar residing in the Library of Vivec in the Temple Canton of Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Assistant Raynila is a Dunmer scholar residing in the Library of Vivec within the Temple Canton in Vivec City, Vvardenfell. She has no unique dialogue.
Athanden Drivam is a Dunmer laborer residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He is located inside Drivam's House on the western shore of the town. He has no unique dialogue.
Ashu-awa is a Dunmer Ashlander residing in the Urshilaku Camp on Vvardenfell.
Athis Telendas is an Ordinator residing in Ebonheart. He does not have any unique dialogue.

Associate Zanon is a Dunmer and a Clockwork Apostle, residing in his workshop in the Reactor District of the Brass Fortress in Clockwork City where he was sponsored by Lector Trivura. During The Precursor, he will send the Vestige across tamriel searching for parts to complete "the Precursor", to the disapointment of his sponsor. At some point he penned the Skeevaton Modification and Operation and The Mystery of Factotums. In exchange for funding his factotum experiments he attempted to fix the Retail Assistant for Mordrold.
Assistant Maren is a Dunmer scholar residing on the lower level of the Library of Vivec in the Temple Canton of Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Ashuna is a Redguard priest of Tu'whacca held hostage by the Withered Hand at Tu'whacca's Throne.

Ashen-Skinned is an Argonian laborer residing at the Temple of the Ancestor Moths in north-eastern Cyrodiil, close by the Ebonheart Pact Elder Scroll Temples. She will walk around the grounds of the Temple of the Ancestor Moth and speak to the Vestige if interacted with. She will only ever be seen around the Temple grounds by the chapel and storehouse.
Ashulerib is a Dunmer Ashlander residing at the Zainab Camp on Vvardenfell. He cannot be spoken with.
Ashlander Flame Healers are hostile generic Dunmer cauterizers from the Erabenimsun Tribe near Almurbalarammi. If detected by them, the Vestige incurs a bounty. They have no unique dialogue.

Ashlander Archers are Dunmer archers from the Erabenimsun Tribe who can be found around Almurbalarammi, which is a restricted area. They will turn hostile if they notice the Vestige, and incur a bounty.
Ashgar is a character residing in Haj Uxith, Coldharbour, in .

Auri-El or Auriel is the elven variant of Akatosh, the chief god of the Nine Divines. Auri-El is the soul of Anui-El, who in turn is the soul of Anu, the Everything. He is often seen as chief of the Aldmeri Pantheon by his followers.
Aubk-i was the Queen of Daggerfall and consort of King Gothryd during the Third Era. As Queen, Aubk-i played a role in events preceding the Warp in the West in 3E 417.

Laloriaran Dynar of Nenalata, the last king of the Ayleids.]] The Ayleids, also known as the Heartland High Elves, Heartland Elves, Saliache, or Wild Elves, were an ancient race of Mer who ruled over Cyrodiil in the first era. Their appearance was said to have been lighter than that of a Dunmer, but not as pale as that of the Altmer. They had varied skin tones from light tan to bronze.

Auberon Flyte is a male Breton in . He and his wife Doryanna Flyte rule Anticlere, a region near the Iliac Bay, which was formerly known as Reich Gradkeep. Auberon led the Knights of the Flame, the guardians and protectors of Anticlere.
Aurnie Vanne is a Breton Monk in Balmora. She is also a member of House Hlaalu.

Aurelinwae is an Altmer spell merchant and plays a central role in the Wizard's Tower plug-in. In addition to spells, she also sells the Hero the furniture and equipment they need to outfit their home at Frostcrag Spire. The rest of her inventory consists of a variety of potions, ingredients and soul gems and 2000 . She also recharges enchanted weapons. Aurelinwae works at the Mystic Emporium in the Market District of the Imperial City.
Avrus Adas is a Dunmer priest in Leyawiin's Chapel of Zenithar. He is also a spell merchant and offers the spells listed below after 8pm.
Audens Avidius is an Imperial Watch guard captain who can often be found patrolling the Market District.
Avita Vesnia is an Imperial priestess of Kynareth. She is first encountered by the Hero at her wayshrine in the Great Forest in western Cyrodiil.
Aurorans are Daedric creatures from Meridia's realm, commanded by Umaril the Unfeathered.

An atronach is one of several species of Daedric creatures or golems, made up almost entirely of a single, pure substance. The name is sometimes applied to human-made constructs that resemble atronachs, but are not Daedra; these creatures are more properly called golems.
Augurius Sialius is an Imperial living in Ebonheart. He can be found inside Hawkmoth Tower, and is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Aumsi is a Nord member of the Imperial Legion living in Ebonheart, Hawkmoth Legion Garrison.
Attelivupis Catius is an Imperial who resides in Buckmoth Legion Fort.
Audania Afronia is an Imperial warrior who resides in the slaver cave of Hinnabi.
Aunius Autrus is an Imperial priest who resides at the Imperial Shrine in Wolverine Hall, Sadrith Mora. He offers a variety of services to the public, and is not involved in any quests.

Prince Attrebus Mede, known as "Treb" to his friends, is a character who appears in and , and is the only son of the Emperor Titus Mede I. He is beloved by the people of Cyrodiil for his acts of heroism and gallantry, but in truth his life is a farce created by the Emperor. His sword was called Flashing.

Aventus Aretino is a Nord child in Windhelm found in the home of his deceased parents. When found, he is performing the Black Sacrament in hopes of contacting the Dark Brotherhood. Desiring the death of Grelod the Kind for mistreating the children at Honorhall Orphanage, he asks the Dragonborn to fulfill the contract. If successful, he gives them the Aretino Family Heirloom.
Avulstein Gray-Mane is a Nord and member of the Gray-Mane clan, a well-established family in the city of Whiterun.
Aurmazl Kaneh is the commander of the Golden Saints residing in Cylarne on the Isle of Flame, in the northwestern part of Shivering Isles.
Autkendo Jansa is a Dark Seducer in the Shivering Isles. She is the Captain of the Mazken Palace Guard in New Sheoth, the home of the Daedric Prince of madness, Sheogorath.
Avon Ravel is a Dunmer Agent, and slaver who resides in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He is located on the bottom level of Hlormaren's keep.
Avoni Dren is a Dunmer noble and a member of House Telvanni, who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.
Avron Gols is a Dunmer Scout and House Hlaalu retainer protecting Rethan Manor. He also offers training.
Avus Belvilo is a Dunmer Agent, and a member of House Hlaalu, residing at the Dren Plantation.
Aviera Nirol is a worshipper of the Daedric Prince Vaermina. She can be found at the Vaermina's Shrine located next to Lake Poppad along with her fellow worshippers Tenville and Aymar Douar.

Aymar Douar is a Dunmer and a worshipper of the Daedric Prince Vaermina. He can be found at the Vaermina's Shrine located next to Lake Poppad along with her fellow worshippers Aviera Nirol and Tenville. He is the one to speak to if one wishes to approach Vaermina. He spends all of his time worshiping Vaermina, praying for a chance to witness one of her true visions.
Aurane Frernis is a Breton Apothecary who owns a shop in the western corridor on the upper level of the Lower Waistworks in Vivec City's Foreign Quarter.
Ayalea was a nymph who lived on the coast of the Iliac Bay in Hammerfell.

Avita Cassiana is an Imperial follower of Azura. She is mentioned in the Worn, Faded Note during the quest "Azura." Avita has a one in four chance of wearing any other piece of armor, a leveled light cuirass. She can cast one leveled spell.

Avalea was a noblewoman of some renown. As a young girl, she was grossly disfigured by a spiteful servant. She then made a deal with Clavicus Vile and obtained the Masque of Clavicus Vile. The mask did not change her physical appearance, but instead gave her the respect and admiration of everyone. She married a rich baron a year and a day later. Then, Clavicus reclaimed his mask. Avalea, pregnant with child, was banished by the baron. Twenty-one years and one day later, Avalea's daughter claimed her vengeance by slaying the Baron.
Avik is a Redguard snake charmer found in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. A retired member of the Mage's Guild, he now preforms outside with his snake between the Bell Tower and Gerrick's Goods.
Atulg gro-Largum is an Orsimer barbarian residing in Shushishi.
Azarg is an Orsimer residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade. He owns a carpentry business named "Shipshape Carpentry" at the docks.
Atroque Santerre is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found tending the flowers near Daggerfall Millworks.
Azareth is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers. He is tasked with keeping an eye out for anything suspicious in Elden Root.
Augustine Derone is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is found inside the Temple of the Divines, sitting on a bench.
Azarati is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk at the Stormhaven's Trade Coster in Wayrest.
Audmund is a Nord barbarian and member of the false Skaal tribe on Solstheim. He can be found either in the Raven Rock Mine or wandering the wilds of the Hirstaang Forest region.

Ayrenn Arana Aldmeri was the High Queen of the Summerset Isles and was the founder first iteration of the Aldmeri Dominion, one of the strongest alliances in history. Ayrenn's life has held significance to the higher powers of Summerset, as her birth and times were foretold by the Scrolls of Praxis.
Aurona Hlaalu is a Dunmer alchemist and a member of House Hlaalu residing in Mournhold, Deshaan. She can be found at her store, Hlaalu Alchemical Goods, selling her wares.
Aza gra-Birgo is an Orsimer armsman and a member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Sentinel.
Atoga is an Orsimer member of the group of outlaws found underneath Daggerfall. She has no unique dialogue.
Attendant Brunna is a Reachman member of the Stonetalon Clan found in the Northwind Mine.
Attiri Steel-Fist is a Nord bard and patron of the Coin Brothers' Cornerclub, in Stormhold.
Aubrey Dathieu is a Breton working at the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Augustina is a Breton commoner who resides in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Aurelie Malarelie is a Breton working at the Wayside Inn, in Wind Keep.
Autrae Snow-Wing is a Nord commoner and patron of the Riverside Inn in Nimalten. She is the owner of Dimi.
Avent Bossard is a noble participating in the festivities at the At-Tura Estate.
Avrippe Favraud is a mystic of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Davon's Watch.
Awanan is a Redguard residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra.
Axulfa Giant-Slayer is a Nord found in Windhelm or behind the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold. She is the author of the book The Divine Prosecution.
Aza is a Khajiit soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found in Camp Merciful Reduction.
Azabesh is an Orsimer standing by the grave of her beloved located south of Goldfolly.
Azalil is a Khajiit chef. He sells his wares in the Seaside Sanctuary.
Atrius Axilla is an Imperial traveling merchant who was attacked by a pack of werewolves while on his way to Rawl'kha.
Avys Areleth is a powerful Dunmer member of the Blackcaster Mages Guild found inside the Eastern Tower of Elinhir.
Aurieae is a powerful Lamia found inside the Serpent's Nest.
Auguste Barathel is a Breton found in the city of Orsinium. He is impossible to interact with, but can be seen talking to Goburbak.
Aureylah is a Redguard residing in Lonesome Desert Tailors in the city of Orsinium.

Attrebus (2E 841–864) was an Imperial (Colovian) soldier of the Third Legion and bodyguard of Amiel Richton. He was born in Cyrodiil (Colovian West) and was age 23 at the time of the events of . He was killed at the hands of Cyrus the Restless.
Azahrr is a Khajiit moon priestess. She survived the Stonefire Cult invasion of the Do'Krin Monastery.
Axel Plourde is a Breton bard residing in Daggerfall. He performs in The Rosy Lion inn.
Averio Coravel is an Imperial brewer located in Morkuldin Haven, Wrothgar. He can be found at Orzorga's Kitchen, selling his wares.

Augurius Bucco was the commander of the Fourth Legion during the First Era. He was described as young and charismatic. Bucco was a popular figure in Cyrodiil; his good looks and practiced oratory catapulted him through the ranks of the Legion hierarchy with unprecedented speed. By the time he was twenty-five he was already wearing the General's Diamond. Upon receiving his generalship he was offered legions in practically every corner of Cyrodiil. He chose the Fourth Legion of Black Marsh as his command.
Avrippe Jegnole is a Breton leatherworker. He sells his wares at his store, The Tightest Fit, in Abah's Landing.
Auridon Marine is a generic Altmer found in multiple locations. They are members of the First Auridon Marines. One of them will join the Vestige as a follower while investigating Silsailen.
Aumfi Bluesky is a Nord priestess found inside the Great Chapel of Dibella in Anvil.
Azara is a Redguard laborer found in Anvil, The Gold Coast. She can be on board of The Prowler. She cannot be interacted with.
Axkiral is a drunkard Nord found in the city of Anvil, Gold Coast. Sometimes she can be seen fighting with Chukka-Li, Cidius or Jolippe in front of Enrick's Public House.
Auridon Paladin, formerly known as the Auridon Battlemage, is a creature card in .
Az-Loh is an Argonian residing in Drinks-With-Crabs's House in Ebonheart.

Aubatha is a Redguard character residing in Bergama. She is the main source of information about Zoreh the Tenacious and the Bergama Signal Fire Sprint, only appearing while the New Life Festival is active.
Aurelia Barbula is a Breton residing in Abah's Landing. She is under the employ of Lady Sulima as a guard tasked with protecting her mansion.
Axel Malveaux is a Breton member of the Undaunted. He is part of the group that went into the City of Ash.
Axelle is a Breton patron of the Stone Oasis Inn in Bergama.
Aurig Mireh is a Golden Saint found at the Shivering Shrine. She must be defeated in order to clear the location.
Aventina Famula is an Imperial enchanter. She sells her wares at her store, Famula's Wonders, in Kvatch.
Aud No-Shirt is a Nord commoner residing in Windhelm, Eastmarch. He is a celebrant of the Konunleikar. He has no unique dialogue.
Atzurbesh is an Orsimer leatherworker working at the Tenfold Tannery in the Tanners and Miners Hall within the Saint Olms Waistworks of Vivec City.
Avrusa Duleri is a member of the Camonna Tong in . She is leading a group of assassins in Khartag Point to punish Khartag for not accepting their ultimatum.
Auditory Stimulators are generic factotum bards that can be found around the Brass Fortress in the Clockwork City playing music.
Aubykka is a Nord residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.
Atorag is an Orsimer fisher located in Exile's Barrow, found fishing near the coast. She is the fish-wife of Chief Gloorot.
Avreg is an Orsimer hunter first met in Bonerock Cavern, during the events of "Riekr Revenge," afterwards he may be found in Orgotha's camp southwest of the Icy Shore Wayshrine.
Avita Pitio is an Imperial drummer who appears in Hakoshae in Northern Elsweyr.
Azadhai gra-Madba is a Orsimer that has taken shelter, like most of the other residents, within the Elinhir sewers away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild.
Aumokel Golden Saints are a Daedra featured in . They use new unique armors and weapons in the Golden Saint style. The weapons are the Greatsword, Warhammer, and Battleaxe.
Avanessa Calladius is a deceased Imperial in that is a part of the Goblins Creation Club content.

The Baliwog is a predatory, amphibious creature that dwells in the lakes, rivers, and bogs of the Shivering Isles. Although the Baliwog is small and walks on all fours, it can deliver a powerful attack and should not be underestimated. Some characters and some books speculate that the Baliwog is an infant Grummite.
Balen Andrano is a Dunmer Trader and member of House Redoran who resides in the Vivec, Redoran Canton. He runs the shop Redoran Trader.
Balis Favani is a Dunmer Spellsword living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Balan is a Redguard who lives in Druegh-jigger's Rest Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. She is a member of the Thieves Guild, and offers training.
Bagamul gro-Dumul Is an Orsimer Guard living in the Fort Darius Imperial Legion base in Gnisis, Morrowind. The base is named after General Darius, who lives in Gnisis as well.

Azzan is the Redguard leader of the Anvil Fighters Guild, and is also a trainer of Blunt at the level of Journeyman for members of the guild. He is known in Anvil for his skills and personality, many in town saying that they would join the guild to work under Azzan. He can be found on the top floor of the Anvil Fighters Guild, either in his office, or in the entrance hall. He wears Steel Armor.

Bacon is a boar that can be found in Dunbarrow Cove if the The Thieves Den official plugin is installed and the fence upgrade has been purchased. He is Khafiz's pet, and the Hero may speak to Khafiz about him. Because Bacon is an essential character, he cannot be killed.

Bacola Closcius is an Imperial publican who resides in the South Wall Cornerclub in Balmora. He will point the Nerevarine to Caius Cosades and donate a brandy for the quest "Brandy for the Fundraising Dinner."
Balgruuf the Greater is the Nord Jarl of Whiterun Hold, residing in his great hall, Dragonsreach. He is a major character in the main quest of .
Babette is a Breton vampire and, as a member of the Dark Brotherhood, she also functions as a merchant of potions and ingredients, as well as being a master trainer of Alchemy.
Balbus is a Nord who roams Skyrim. He is a fan of the Gourmet and is collecting ingredients for him.
Azzadal is a deceased Redguard bard whose ghost appears after the Dragonborn jumps into the pool from the spawn location in Bard's Leap Summit.
Azzada Lylvieve is a Redguard farmer who can be found in Dragon Bridge chopping wood.

Balagog gro-Nolob, or more frequently known as The Gourmet in his books, is an Orsimer residing at the Nightgate Inn, southeast of Dawnstar. He is described by the innkeeper as being more refined than most other Orcs.
Badnir is a Nord warrior who resides in the Whistling Mine, southeast of Winterhold.

Bagrak is an Orsimer found in the Orc Stronghold of Mor Khazgur in Haafingar. She is the wife of Chief Larak, and mother of Borgakh the Steel Heart. She spends all day and night patrolling the watchtowers, and carries in her inventory a key to the chief's longhouse in the center of the stronghold.
Badala Velothren is a Dunmer Agent who resides in the Ashlands of Morrowind. She is standing outside the door to Ebernanit.
Badama Andarys is a Dunmer sorceress who resides in the cave of Ibar-Dad.
Balen Sedrethi is a Dunmer Enforcer who resides in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. He is a House Cousin of House Hlaalu and can be found inside Curio Manor.
Balen Vendu is a Dunmer who resides in Sadrith Mora on the island of Vvardenfell in Morrowind.
Balis Sari is a hostile Dunmer agent who can be found in the cave Abanabi, Abernanit. He also offers training, if the Nerevarine can speak to him.
Bailey is one of the two dogs Rena Bruiant owns. He follows Rena around Chorrol just like her other dog, Kezune. During the day they can be found in the Chapel of Stendarr.
Baadargo is a Khajiit slave who resides in the cave Addamasartus.

Baldor Iron-Shaper is a Skaal blacksmith who resides in the Skaal Village. Until the shout Bend Will has been used on it, he is one of the villagers building a temple around the Wind Stone. Afterwards, during the day he can be seen outside, tending the forge. At night he can be found inside his house. As with any blacksmith, Baldor sells armor, weapons, and smithing materials. Unlike most blacksmiths, however, Baldor also sells ancient Nordic pickaxes, stalhrim weapons and armor, and raw stalhrim.
Bakh gro-Sham is an Orsimer agent who resides in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold. He works undercover to find out who is planning an assassination attempt on the King's mother.
Azuk gro-Rugob is an Orsimer warrior who resides within the daedric shrine of Ibishammus. He can be found protecting a shrine dedicated to Malacath in the Underworks of the Vivec, Foreign Quarter.

Azbi-ra is a Khajiit found in a house right next to Speckled Shell Plantation in the region of Khenarthi's Roost. She is the daughter of Yanalir and sister of Zaban-ma. She started making the illegal drug Skooma to obtain money for the family.
Badbog gra-Shug is an Orsimer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton on the Ascadian Isles on Vvardenfell, Morrowind.
Balithil is an Bosmer sailor on the Wave Cutter who resides in the Aegis of Auri-El in Vulkhel Guard, Auridon. After the last voyage, he is refusing to return to work on accounts of his sea-sickness.
Azlakha is an Orsimer residing on the island of Betnikh. The Vestige will meet her during parts of the quest "The Bloodthorn Plot."
Azbishan is a Khajiit residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Balin Remly is a Breton residing in Glenumbra, High Rock. He and his brother Armel are out setting traps to catch harpies to take their eggs.

Azeriba is a Khajiit residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She used to be an adventurer and went exploring Tamriel, but after discovering the Ilessan Tower, she realized adventuring was not for her. She now stays in the city and does not venture out anymore.
Azbiasur is a Khajiit residing in the city of Woodhearth, Greenshade.
Balfring is a Nord barbarian and member of the false Skaal tribe on Solstheim. He can be found inside the Raven Rock Mine.
Baham is a Bosmer who works at the College of Aldmeri Propriety in Auridon.
Baizad is a Khajiit working and residing at the Laughing Moons Plantation.

Badali is a Khajiit Crescent Moons Acolyte priest residing at the Temple of the Crescent Moon, in the region of Khenarthi's Roost. She is trying to perform spells, but all she can make is a dust cloud. Mikarur will shout after her every time a new dust cloud erupts.
Bad Swimmer is a Khajiit merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, Swimmer's Stuff, in Haven.
Azezin is a Khajiit residing in Khenarthi's Roost, in the port city of Mistral hanging laundry outside The Hissing Phial (Online).
Bakhig is a dangerous Khajiit with an obsession for spiders found inside Entila's Folly.
Azum is a Khajiit and a business partner of Hadran. She is found at his caravan in the Reaper's March.
Baileet is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Sentinel.
Balabar is a Redguard tailor residing in the city of Sentinel. He can be found at the Sentinel Bazaar in Sentinel.
Badila Avani is a Dunmer blacksmith. She works at the Ebonheart Unified Metalworks in Ebonheart.
Azeez-Eix is an Argonian member of the [[Mages Guild (Online)|Mages Guild] residing in his house in the city of Ebonheart.
Badami Teryon is a Dunmer residing in the city of Ebonheart.
Balaru Ven is a Dunmer commoner afflicted with the Llodos Plague. She resides in the Flan House in Quarantine Serk.
Azdazi is a Khajiit commoner found inside the manor in Skywatch.
Azeenus is an Argonian found in the Silent Mire. He gives the quest "Cold-Blooded Vengeance."
Azei at-Owynok is a Redguard found at Ancestor's Landing and the Sunken Road.
Azimbul gro-Shatur is an Orsimer member of the Mages Guild who can be found at the guild hall on Eyevea.
Azshalku is a Dunmer Ashlander competing in The Champion Division at the Thizzrini Arena.
Azuruna is a Khajiit working at the Phynaster's Stride in Haven.
Bahrar is a Redguard blacksmith and owner of The Twice-Blessed Temper, in Sentinel.
Bailiff Sagabar is a member of the Bitterhand Bandits who infiltrated the Fell's Run Guard to partake in a heist aiming to rob the local jeweler.
Bailiff Togbrig is an Orsimer member of the town guard of Fell's Run, Rivenspire.
Baimora al-Bergama is a Redguard cultist and dancer found in Skywatch. She has no unique dialogue.

Bakkhara is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found at the entrance of the Elden Hollow, where she is seeking aid in putting an end to Canonreeve Oraneth's foul plans. Later, she can be found in the Elden Root Mages Guildhall, tending to Kargand.
Baladar is a Dunmer weaponsmith. He sells his wares at his stall, Baladar's Blades, in the market of Nimalten.
Balmeg gro-Bug is an Orsimer patron of the Sisters of the Sands Inn in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r.
Bandaari Peddler is a Khajiit merchant residing in the city of Skywatch.
Backstreet Brigand is a Breton who resides in the city of Wayrest.
Backstreet Thug is a character residing in the city of Wayrest.
Bagul is an Orsimer bandit and associate of a local reaver named Dugan the Red found with him at his camp, Dugan's Knoll.
Azdarmu the Awakened is a powerful Wamasu found inside the ruins of Skyreach Hold.

Bailiff Fakimal is a deceased Redguard found at his home in the city of Bergama, Alik'r Desert. He was ordered to deliver corpses to the Withered Hand to protect the city by the Magistrate Sulma. When he wrote a letter to resign from his post he got murdered.
Bagrugbesh is an Orsimer residing in the city of Orsinium. Bagrugbesh is in charge of Orsinium's food stores, and because of the food shortage, has ordered a contract on the poachers which caused it.
Badush is an Orsimer residing in the outlaws refuge beneath the city of Orsinium.
Azhnolga is an Orsimer found in Ufgel's Bathhouse and Laundry in the city of Orsinium. She has no unique dialogue.
Bagula is an Orsimer noble found in Morkuldin Haven, trying to cut down a tree near a barn at the southern entrance to the Haven.
Balarkh is an Orsimer warrior found in the Clan Longhouse in Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar. He has been married to Ashgel by the High Priestess Solgra under the church of Trinimac in Orsinium.
Bakhum is a Khajiit found at the docks of Abah's Landing. He seeks protection for his journey to the Maw of Lorkhaj to visit his family member Takanradh, who is a monk there.
Azimaz is a Khajiit commoner who can found taking care of the horses just outside Anvil's northern gates in the Gold Coast.
Baagug is an Orsimer found in Narhag's House by the Midnight Riders just outside the northern gates of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Bahara is an Redguard armsman found offering her services in Anvil Fighters Guild in Anvil, Gold Coast.

Azura's Spirit is an avatar of the Daedric Prince Azura, that appears before the Nerevarine at the end of the main quest in , inside the Citadel of Dagoth Ur, and at the conclusion of in Mournhold's Temple courtyard.
Baan Dar's Mender is the generic name given to certain soldiers of Baan Dar, located at The Five Finger Dance.
Azeez-Eix is an Argonian member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Ebonheart.
Balia the Light is a Bosmer member of the Shadow Walkers clan found at The Moonless Walk.
Babhaq is a Redguard laborer residing in Belkarth. He works at the nearby orchard, gathering apples. He has no unique dialogue.
Bahrez is an Argonian clothier who can be found in her house in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.

Bahree is a Redguard laborer residing in Mournhold's Fighters Guild, in the Training Yard. Her daily routine consists of sweeping the floor on the south corners of the Yard. She has no unique dialogue.
